title: Road closure notice
description: A transportation department notice closing a road, bridge or rail line for a natural hazard (debris-flow forecast, landslide, earthquake damage): the route and limits, the reason, the start time, the detour, who is exempt and when it will be reviewed.

examples: State Route 12 from milepost 14 to milepost 22 (both directions)
Forecast heavy rain over the Cedar Ridge Fire burn area. Debris flows are likely and can cross the road with little warning.
Closed at 5:00 PM PST Thursday, November 5
Use State Route 101 north to County Road 4.
Reviewed at 6:00 AM Friday after the storm passes and crews inspect the road.
